messages:
support-chris: :rotating_light: Customer DataWave reporting p99 API spikes for embeddings in us-west1 since ~03:00 UTC. They see p99 ~9s, p50 ~120ms. Customer attached traces. Ticket 9876.

emily_support: Adding SRE and infra. Escalating. cc @jordan_sre @maria_infra

jordan_sre: On it. Any recent infra rollouts in us-west1 around 02:30-03:15?

maria_infra: We pushed CUDA 12.2.1-rc build to a small canary at 02:45, then widened at 02:58. Also host kernel security backport at 01:50 on some nodes.

jordan_sre: OK signal. I'm seeing normalized latency from our traces correlate with host IO qdepth spikes on node pool usw2-rtg-3. Investigating NVMe stats.

maria_infra: iostat snapshot from affected host:
```
Device      r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await r_await w_await svctm %util
nvme0n1   120.4   98.2  4096.0  8192.0   102.4    42.31  21.3   12.4    3.6   0.50  94.1
```
avgqu-sz high and %util >90

jordan_sre: Also GPU driver / kernel messages show page cache writeback stalls around same timestamps. Suspect host kernel backport interacting with NVMe scheduler under the new CUDA path.

emily_support: Customer repro steps (from their support log):
1) hit embeddings endpoint with batch size 8, 60rps steady
2) after ~10m p99 climbs
3) sample curl trace: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d @batch.json -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>'`

jordan_sre: Repro locally on a canary: when we saturate NVMe on same host instance type, p99 jumps similarly. Repro command used:
```
fio --name=randread --rw=randread --bs=16k --iodepth=64 --numjobs=8 --size=2G --runtime=600
```

maria_infra: Short-term mitigations:
- Rollback CUDA canary on affected hosts to previous driver (12.1.y) for the canary pool.
- Update routing policy to shift embeddings traffic from usw2 to eu1 for customers with >=P99 SLA until mitigations done.
- Throttle user-level IO on inference hosts via cgroups: `echo 32 > /sys/block/nvme0n1/queue/nr_requests` (test on canary first)

jordan_sre: Implemented routing change for DataWave (manual override) and started CUDA rollback on 2/5 canaries. Early observations: p99 down to ~1.4s on first rollback host.

ops-bot: Deploy: rollback-cuda-12.1 -> hosts: usw2-rtg-3a, usw2-rtg-3b (started) :gear:

emily_support: Noted that this affects embeddings most due to their I/O pattern + kv cache writes. Logging follow-up with customer and requested traffic pattern dump.

support-chris: Customer happy with temporary relief; asked about ETA for full fix.

maria_infra: Plan next 24h: complete rollback across pool, run controlled fio soak tests, then re-evaluate kernel backport ordering. If stable, we'll reintroduce CUDA canary with nvme qdepth tuning. If rollback insufficient, escalate to vendor driver/firmware with NVMe vendor.

jordan_sre: Action items:
- jordan_sre: finish rollback on remaining canaries (ETA 2h)
- maria_infra: run fio soak and submit kernel/driver bug report (ETA 6h)
- emily_support: keep DataWave updated; collect more traces (ETA 1h)
- support-chris: create incident ticket and link customer thread (INC-2026-091)

emily_support: I'll file a postmortem template now and tag owners.

support-chris: Thanks all :thumbsup:
